messages:
alex: quick halftime check — are we aligned for the 18:00 UTC changelog cutoff? I want to lock the release branch at 18:15 and start packaging at 18:30.

marta: yes for cutoff time. ownership clarifications: docs -> @jin, sampleapps -> @sam, sdk packaging -> me. infra/ops to confirm any last-minute infra migrations (cc @ken).

ken: infra side is green. no migrations scheduled for tonight. I'll keep an eye on the GPU pool quotas during the canary.

sam: sampleapps status: 5 open PRs, 2 are docstring-only, 1 is a test flake fix, 2 are feature toggles that need review. Can we prioritize review for the 2 feature PRs? PR links: https://github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/421, /422

alex: pinging for reviews — @marta can you grab 421? @jin can you eyeball 422 for doc compatibility?

marta: grabbing 421 now. plan: if green CI + 1 approving review, ship into release branch pre-cutoff.

jin: will review 422 in ~30m. also pushing a tiny wording change to the quickstarts (english only) — not a changelog blocker but FYI.

ci-bot: build #12456 finished: sampleapps/unit passed, sampleapps/integration flaky (1 failed test: tests/e2e/test_login.py::test_social_login). Retrying in 2m.

sam: that flaky e2e is my recent change. running local repro now, should have a fix by EOD. If fix lands after cutoff, we can ship sampleapps as a partial rollout and flag the failing test in the release notes.

alex: about changelog entries — please add one-line items under the correct component headers in docs/CHANGELOG.md PRs. We're keeping the changelog terse: feature/impact/owner. Example: "cli: add --config-path alias for quickstart (sam)"

marta: reminder — SDK packages need version bump to 1.5.0-rc1 and python wheel build must pass. I'll handle npm and go module bumps. Jenkins job is 'devex-release/package-build'.

ci-bot: devex-release/package-build queued -> building.

ken: canary strategy: start with 2% traffic on hosted, monitor latency and error rate for 30m, then 25% for 30m, then full roll. If token error rate >0.5% or 95p latency > 800ms, rollback. I'll own the rollback and alerting hooks.

alex: good, please post times for the canary window here once scheduled. Also need a docs smokecheck after packaging — @jin can you coordinate a docs review run and confirm quickstarts render?

jin: will run smokecheck after package-build completes. command I use: `scripts/docs_build.sh && scripts/quickstart_smoke.sh --langs py,js` — will post artifacts.

sam: action item: I will merge the sampleapp fix PR and mark the flaky test with xfail if needed.

marta: final owner list for cutover: packaging/me, docs/jin, sampleapps/sam, infra/ken, release coord/alex. Cutover timeline: 18:15 branch lock, 18:30 package build (& docs smoke), 19:00 canary start.

alex: thanks. last asks before I close the window: everyone confirm they can be reachable between 18:00-20:30 UTC?

ken: reachable, will be on pager.

marta: reachable, stand-by for packaging.

jin: reachable once build artifacts are up.

sam: reachable, merging the fix now.

alex: great — I'll post a final reminder at 17:50 UTC and open the release PR for approvals. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: note: docs smokecheck artifacts uploaded -> https://artifacts.internal/docs/smoke/1755000000

alex: closing thread — will reopen if any blockers crop up. Thanks all!
